function.plot: The news montage sets the world before anyone speaks: AI in the headlines, the Mountain Man introduction, the cue into the standup.
function.liam: None directly; it frames the room he is about to be found in.
function.others: None; it is film, not a scene.
function.comedy: The montage's own cuts and Sam's pause.
function.spectacle: The whole scene is a 111 second film; it plays as real time and the data cannot measure it.
setupPayoff: the news frame that the press scenes later echo

ifRemoved: The show would open cold on the standup with no frame. The film's length is the only lever: it is fixed at 111 seconds and any shortening is an edit to the video, not to the script.

suggestions.note: No script saving is possible here. If the film is re-cut, judge it by the clock; the allowance in the analysis settings (111 s) should be updated to match the new length.
